comment: A room change as an exit makes it ($A962, port/rooms.c exit_to), for tools that visit rooms (tools/bandsurvey.py): pokes after a gameplay frame, {area} and {room} as two hex digits each. The player starts at x $1080, y $1040 (near the room's top-left: the camera at the map's top), arrival 2 (walked in), the area's data reloaded, room change 1 (the next room).
